# LSTM on the validation period (generated by `scripts/run_lstm.py`)

Dataset sha256 `ee5bc65756cd7976...`, git commit `6381f81ce5` (working tree dirty: False); torch 2.14.1+cpu; 4 threads, CPU only. Validation targets 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30; the test period was not loaded. Scenario A. Tuning: 12 random trials per horizon (XGBoost used 30; see protocol deviation log) on feature set L4; early stopping on validation, so the numbers are mildly optimistic. Headline = mean prediction of 3 seeds (same convention as XGBoost).

## Horizon 1 h (train samples 19,887; validation samples 4,367)

Tuning: 12 trials in 17.3 min; best trial #7: hidden=64, lr=0.006689, dropout=0.02, weight_decay=4e-06.

| feature set | MAE per seed, mean +- sd (MW) | MAE of 3-seed mean prediction | vs best ridge (CI) | vs XGBoost headline (CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| L1_history_calendar | 1,576 +- 48 | 1,503 | +414 (+358 to +489) | +399 (+349 to +461) |
| L2_holidays | 1,620 +- 38 | 1,520 | +431 (+363 to +513) | +416 (+352 to +484) |
| L4_full_A | 1,659 +- 15 | 1,584 | +495 (+438 to +575) | +480 (+429 to +545) |

Reference on the same samples: best ridge (ridge_full_abs) 1,089 MW; XGBoost headline (3-seed mean) 1,104 MW. Negative differences mean the LSTM is better (paired MAE, 95% moving-block bootstrap).
